text:
alex: RFC follow-up — proposing operator-enforced quorum for on-prem bundle activations. goal: avoid split-brain applies when operator restarts mid-activation.
maya: +1. can you sketch what 'quorum' maps to? control-plane nodes? operator replicas?
sam: I think quorum should be defined in two dimensions: control-plane votes + component-level ack. e.g., requiredQuorum: 3 and componentAckThreshold: 0.8  
irene: what about tiny clusters (1-2 nodes)? fallback path needed or we'll block upgrades forever. maybe a forced-bypass with audit log and operator approval.
alex: yes — fallback: operator can force-activate but we emit sealed audit event and require an out-of-band confirmation step. default policy: require majority of nodes (ceil(n/2)) OR configured numeric quorum if present.
julian: how does this play with staged activation windows and canary shards? we already have canary percentages for model artifacts.
sam: canary stays the same, but activation is gated by quorum for final promotion. sequence: 1) canary apply on N% 2) health checks 3) quorum marker set when control-plane nodes witness final manifest 4) activation proceeds
maya: pseudo example?
alex: here — manifest excerpt: 

```
apiVersion: redwood/v1
kind: BundleActivationPolicy
metadata:
  name: enterprise-default
spec:
  requiredQuorum: 3
  quorumMode: majority  # options: majority|fixed
  componentAckThreshold: 0.75
  forceBypass: true  # requires manual approval if used
  auditAnnotation: "quorum-bypass-required"
```

irene: ok. we should also record which operator replica proposed the activation + leader epoch to help root-cause when state diverges.
ajax typo: alex: ^alex — agreed. add leaderEpoch and proposerId to the audit blob.
infra-bot: deploy-check: policy-schema validated against registry v1.2.1 — OK :white_check_mark: 
julian: edge case: a node is partitioned and later rejoins with older KV-cache — do we block its self-repair?
sam: plan: when node rejoins, it must validate manifest hash and run reconcile in read-only until it fetches missing blobs. we avoid auto-activations from stale state.
maya: timeline for prototyping? can we bake this into operator v0.18 alpha?
alex: yes — target: v0.18-alpha. I'll carve a small prototype: quorum coordinator component + audit events. will open PR with tests next week.
irene: add e2e test where operator restarts mid-activation and we assert no double-apply.
julian: also test forced-bypass metrics (we should emit a metric we can alert on).
alex: noted. will add metric: onprem.activation.quorum_bypass_count and trace tags: proposerId, leaderEpoch, activationId.
maya: ok sounds good. small nit: make the audit blob tamper-evident (signed by operator HSM or cluster KMS).
sam: agree — sign with node key; if HSM unavailable, sign with ephemeral operator key and mark as weaker.
alex: thanks all — I'll post RFC diff in #architecture when draft PR lands. any objections?
julian: no objections from me. :thumbsup:
maya: LGTM
irene: LGTM
sam: LGTM
infra-bot: reminder: run integration suite on onprem-nightly after PR merged.
